thread:
ella: Hey team — new webinar pitch: 'Session Lab: Hands-on failover & cost-slicing for LLM demos'. Goal: compact, tactical, with a live lab that breaks and recovers. Target date May 16. Draft abstract below.

ella: Draft abstract: A practical session for engineers building customer-facing LLM features. We show how to measure end-to-end demo economics, apply batching/cache/quant knobs, and implement an ops-first failover so demos stay up under load. Includes a short live lab and postmortem.

marco: Sounds good. Keep slides <12 and demo short. People tune out long live demos.

rachel: I can run the live lab and the fault script. Free May 12-16 mornings PT. Need a pinned container tag and a small dataset.

tony: I'll do the benchmark slide + one-pager: p50/p95, tokens/sec, cost/1k, and a simple decision table for when to quantize vs cache.

ella: proposed split: intro (ella), benchmarks (tony), lab+fault (rachel). marco you moderate?

marco: yes, happy to host and field Qs. I'll also run a 60s poll after benchmarks: "What do you optimize first?" options: latency/cost/reliability.

rachel: demo prompts coming: three short tasks for smoke tests. Also need whitelist for demo runner IPs.

ella: run-of-show (draft):
```
00:00 - Welcome + outcomes (ella) 3m
03:00 - Product framing + buyer pain (ella) 5m
08:00 - Benchmarks & 3 takeaways (tony) 7m
15:00 - Poll (marco) 1m
16:00 - Live lab: baseline + tuning (rachel) 12m
28:00 - Inject load -> trigger fallback (rachel) 5m
33:00 - Postmortem & cost delta (tony) 4m
37:00 - Quick tips & checklist slide (ella) 3m
40:00 - Q&A (panel) 20m
```

ella: rehearsals: tech dry run May 9 9am PT, full dress May 14 11am PT. Can folks confirm?

rachel: May 9 OK. May 14 I can make 11am.

tony: confirm both. I'll bring numbers for bench slide.

marco: confirmed May 14 full dress. I'll draft seed Qs.

deploy-bot: Staging slot reserved May 9 09:00 PT for 90 minutes. Reminder scheduled 24h prior.

ella: preflight checklist (short): slides in drive, pinned demo image + sha, telemetry dashboard link, fallback routing policy, white-list for demo, backup recording of demo flow.

marco: please add a single CTA on registration: 'Reserve your seat' and a field 'Your top constraint' so we can compare poll answers to form submissions.

ella: copy drafts for marketing: H1: 'Session Lab: Make live LLM demos resilient and cost-predictable' Subhead: 'Real metrics, a short failover lab, and a reproducible ops playbook.' Thoughts?

rachel: good. prefer shorter subhead. maybe: 'Real metrics, a live failover, practical playbook.'

tony: +1. Also will prepare a one-slide adoption checklist we can put in follow-up.

ella: owners: slides/ella, benchmarks/tony, demo/rachel, host/marco. I'll draft the registration page and share links.

marco: I'll create calendar invites and the gating checklist doc. Seed Qs: 1) How do you measure demo success? 2) What fallback policies do you use? 3) Biggest blocker to deploying demos?

rachel: demo prompts (short): 'Summarize this spec in 2 bullets', 'Shorten this outreach email to 1 sentence', 'Given traces, suggest top 2 mitigations'. Drive link with cases: https://rwd.infer/session-lab-cases

tony: I'll post sample dashboard numbers (p50 120ms, p95 420ms, tokens/sec 250, cost/1k $0.18) by Monday EOD for slides.

ella: perfect. thanks all — I'll loop back with registration copy and rehearsal checklist. :sparkles:
